independent_audit.freshness: synthetic same-run self-test; not an independent scientific audit

claim.text: Within this synthetic finite grammar, a contextual partial distinction table is a minimal survivor for retaining one ordered distinction.
claim.obligation: Retain the distinction between marks a and b after ordered attempts pq while allowing qp to differ.

assumptions: finite marks used only as presentation syntax
finite marks used only as presentation syntax
quotient classes treated as functional objects

weakness_edges.witness: Forget quotient classes and retain only the tested contextual distinction table; the frozen ordered distinction remains.
Forget metric values and retain the zero-distance quotient; the frozen ordered distinction remains.

weakening_coverage.detail: The partial distinction table survived after equivalence closure and quotient objects were removed.
The equivalence quotient survived after metric values and triangle structure were forgotten.

controls.expected_effect: Removing object and equivalence assumptions leaves the root obligation expressible.
controls.observed_effect: The partial relation retained the distinction and the stronger object presentations were not needed.

controls.expected_effect: The partial relation should survive if quotient and metric structure are ornamental.
controls.observed_effect: The partial relation survived and strictly dominated both stronger tested presentations.

controls.expected_effect: Renaming candidate and outcome labels must not change the computed frontier.
controls.observed_effect: The frontier was unchanged after label erasure.

controls.expected_effect: A fixture with a declared but graph-inconsistent frontier must be rejected.
controls.observed_effect: The validator rejected the inconsistent frontier mutation.

controls.expected_effect: Removing the distinction attempt that separates a and b must erase the frozen obligation.
controls.observed_effect: The erased-attempt mutation failed the obligation test.

controls.expected_effect: Forcing pq and qp to agree must remove the registered N01 witness.
controls.observed_effect: The commuting mutation failed the ordered-distinction test.

controls.expected_effect: Erasing the finite history must remove the persistence claim while leaving static marks intact.
controls.observed_effect: The history-erased mutation lost the persistence witness.

controls.expected_effect: Coarsening below the separating resolution must merge a and b.
controls.observed_effect: The coarsened finite table no longer retained the obligation.

controls.expected_effect: A non-metric partial-relation family should reproduce the tested behavior.
controls.observed_effect: The rival family reproduced the behavior with fewer assumptions.

controls.expected_effect: No ring, lattice, or locality claim may be inferred from this distinction table.
controls.observed_effect: The scope guard rejected a synthetic ring-topology promotion.

controls.expected_effect: An independent entropy state must be rejected when a one-surface claim is made.
controls.observed_effect: The validator rejected the independent-entropy mutation.

controls.expected_effect: A single-record fixture must not promote itself to full field dynamics.
controls.observed_effect: The claim ceiling remained synthetic scratch process data.

controls.observed_effect: The held-out order was evaluated independently and remained explicitly fixture-scoped.

controls.expected_effect: Freezing admissible distinction-changing updates must eliminate the drive and prevent a tooth.
controls.observed_effect: The frozen mutation produced zero gradient and the process emitted HOLD_NO_GRADIENT.

controls.expected_effect: Closing the frozen obligation must collapse its distinction potential.
controls.observed_effect: After obligation closure the measured potential difference vanished.

controls.expected_effect: An externally injected numerical slope must not count as intrinsic drive.

controls.expected_effect: At least one candidate response must change the frozen obligation-relative potential.
controls.observed_effect: The partial distinction candidate reduced the unresolved potential by two finite units.

drive.functional: finite count of unresolved frozen ordered distinctions
drive.orientation: positive magnitude points toward reducing the frozen obligation-relative distinction potential
drive.witness: The candidate update closes two of three frozen finite distinction obligations without an injected slope.

entropy_geometry.scope_note: Only the process invariant is exercised; no scientific entropy formula or geometry is admitted.

transition.reason: A licensed, intrinsic, obligation-coupled finite distinction gradient exists and all controls pass.

reopen_triggers: A new weaker candidate survives the same obligation.
A new weakening operator is registered.
The licensed gradient changes, vanishes, becomes extrinsic, or decouples from the frozen obligation.
The distinction, history, resolution, or test battery changes.
An audit finds label leakage or a definitionally fixed result.
